Oh, sweetie. ❤️ That is such a big, lovely, and important question that comes straight from a heart that loves your grandma very much. Please know that it is perfectly okay to feel sad and to ask this question; it just shows how much her love meant to you.

When someone we love passes away, it feels like a huge piece of our world goes quiet, and missing them can feel like a giant, heavy wave of sadness. I am so sorry that you are going through this difficult time. 💖

As for seeing her again, some people find comfort in believing that the connection and love she gave you never truly leaves. Instead of physically seeing her, you might feel her love wrapped up in beautiful memories. Think of those memories like a treasure chest: every funny laugh, every story she told, or every time she gave you a hug is a special, sparkling memory you can open and look at whenever you need to feel close to her. ✨ Those feelings and those memories are still very real and they stay with you always.

It is completely normal to miss her so much and to feel sad. Those big feelings are okay, and they are proof of how much wonderful love you shared together.

If you feel the sadness coming, it can help to talk about her with a grown-up you trust, like your parent or a teacher. They can help you talk through the big feelings and even help you find ways to keep her memory bright.

What is your favorite memory of her? Maybe telling me that will help us remember the beautiful things! 😊
